phase: Phase B focused local qualification of the broker-forced liquidation model over the former March 2020 failure region
sourceBinding: Both runs were launched with run-backtest.ps1 -RunEvidence and without -BaselineContract/-BaselineRegister (the frozen contract asserts the full 2019-01-01..2026-06-30 window). Each qualification run records the clean committed source revision together with the exact algorithm binary (DLL SHA-256), launcher, configuration, runtime identities, invocation and result hash: the machine-generated marketlab-run-invocation-runN.json files record the repository HEAD, the clean-tree check, the hashes and the exact launcher arguments, and the marketlab-run-outcome-runN.json files record the exit codes, the zero engine-error count and the results SHA-256, which equals the SHA-256 of the committed canonical results.json. This is strong provenance evidence; without a source-bound build receipt for this bounded run it is not a cryptographic proof that the DLL was compiled from that HEAD. This evidence directory is committed after the source revision and changes only evidence/docs, not executable source.

window.note: Frozen baseline parameter values; only single-anchor-end-date is bounded.

resultsJsonDeterminismNote: The complete persisted strategy result is byte-identical across the two executions. Other generated run artifacts (logs, timestamps, elapsed times) naturally differ; only results.json is compared.

canonicalResults.role: Complete run result: every closed basket record with its liquidation trace and surviving leg trace, so the least-profitable-first selection can be reconstructed for every forced close (each leg's side, lots and entry price; each episode's trigger quote; each liquidation's realized P/L and ordinal).

leastProfitableFirstNote: Independent reconstruction confirmed each of the 30 historical forced closes selected the actual least-profitable open position at that step.
equalProfitTieRule: higher immutable trade number first; established by the focused unit test LiquidationTests.EqualProfitTiesCloseTheHigherImmutableTradeNumberFirst, not by the historical run (which encountered no equal-profit tie)
supersededRuns: E:\MarketLab\phaseb-march2020\ (pre-correction survivor-only economics; not qualification evidence)
E:\MarketLab\phaseb-march2020-correction\ (corrected economics but no -RunEvidence source binding; superseded by this directory)
notCommitted: The full run directories (log.txt, LEAN result packets) stay local outside Git under E:\MarketLab\phaseb-march2020-review2\; the canonical results.json and the source-bound invocation/outcome records are committed here.
